item.title: Substance Use Navigators
item.description: Overview Substance use navigators (SUNs) are peer counselors or social workers that help stabilized patients with substance use disorders from facilities like Emergency Rooms (ERs) enter outpatient clinic or rehabilitation programs for long-term treatment.

item.title: Electroconvulsive Therapy (ECT)
item.description: Overview Electroconvulsive therapy (ECT) is a medical procedure that runs electrical currents to the brain and triggers seizures for mental health conditions that are otherwise treatment-resistant.
